pricing_note: Estimates from configured GPT-4o rates and embedding rate USD 0.02/million input tokens; not invoices.

scope_note: Evaluation covers useful content retained in the verified index. Excluded or uncertain PDF regions are outside answerable coverage. This benchmark does not establish complete PDF extraction or indexing coverage.
evaluation_note: One frozen full-test execution. The numeric threshold is met within the declared retained-index scope; this does not establish complete PDF coverage or all Advanced bonus conditions.
